weakness: Flat shop network; VMC program share open to any device on the Wi-Fi with no password; router unmanaged (default admin password until 2026-08-12, firmware never updated); no monitoring
remediation_plan: Small business router with a guest network for visitors and the alarm panel and a separate wired segment for the laptop and VMC; password on the VMC share; router logging on and checked monthly
milestones: 2026-09-15 share password on; 2026-10-15 router installed; 2026-10-31 segments tested from a guest device
resources_required: Router about $400 once; IT technician about 4 hours

weakness: No backup the laptop cannot overwrite; CAM settings not backed up; 30-day versions only
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a., b., c., d.[03]); P03 G-032, G-054
remediation_plan: Weekly backup of Jobs, records, and CAM settings to a drive kept disconnected between backups plus a second cloud backup service; quarterly test restore
milestones: 2026-10-15 drive and service in use; 2026-10-31 first full test restore recorded
resources_required: Drive about $120 once; backup service about $100 a year

weakness: Released OEM programs not protected from change; 2 of 10 VMC programs differed from the Jobs copy
remediation_plan: Read-only Released folder with file hashes; compare before each OEM run; controller edits saved back and recorded on the traveler; tell the OEM about the 2 differences
milestones: 2026-09-15 differences reviewed with the OEM quality contact; 2026-11-30 Released folder built for all about 180 programs; 2026-12-31 compare step on every OEM traveler

weakness: No MFA on the accounting SaaS administrator account; email MFA by text message
remediation_plan: Authenticator-app MFA on accounting and the productivity suite; recovery codes on the emergency access sheet; password manager
milestones: 2026-09-30 MFA on and tested on both

weakness: No remote support rules; unattended access had been on
source: P07 assessment (AC-17a.[01] to a.[03]); P03 G-007
remediation_plan: POL-01 6.5 rule; confirm the technician uses MFA on the tool account; remove the tool when not in use
milestones: 2026-09-04 rule adopted; 2026-09-30 technician MFA confirmed in writing

weakness: Customer information processed in a consumer AI assistant and emailed to a processor; no approved or prohibited external systems
source: P07 assessment (AC-20a.02, b.); P03 G-009, G-022
remediation_plan: Approved external systems list (POL-01 8.2); training opt-out and deletion of chats with customer content (P10); processors get PO and spec only
milestones: 2026-09-30 AI chats deleted and opt-out set; 2026-10-31 processors told in writing

weakness: No visitor log, escort rule, or key list
source: P07 assessment (PE-08a. to c.); P03 G-015 (FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(ix))
remediation_plan: Paper visitor log at the door kept one year; escort rule; key list
milestones: 2026-09-15 log in use; 2026-09-30 key list done

weakness: No media sanitization; retired laptop and old USB sticks hold job files
source: P07 assessment (MP-06a.[01] to b.); P03 G-013 (FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(vii))
remediation_plan: Encrypt-then-reset the retired laptop or use a certified recycler; destroy old sticks; disposal record
milestones: 2026-10-31 retired laptop and 6 sticks handled and recorded

weakness: No review before posting or periodic website review
remediation_plan: Photo check before posting; quarterly website and social media review
milestones: 2026-08-12 photo removed; 2026-09-30 first quarterly review recorded
